sources.note: Ares is an LLM-agent RTL optimizer that raises the per-call reasoning effort only after progress stalls, and reports the normalized dollar cost of every call next to the power-area-delay figure of merit.
sources.title: ARES: Adaptive Reasoning-Effort Steering for PPA- and Cost-Aware RTL Optimization with LLM Agents

sources.note: Formulates test-time compute allocation across queries as a bandit learning problem so that harder queries get more compute and easier ones get less.
sources.title: Strategic Scaling of Test-Time Compute: A Bandit Learning Approach
